marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure Momentum
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech software and hardware producers reported sustained high capital expenditure on AI data centers, maintaining strong order backlogs for leading chip suppliers.
marketLayer.inference: Continued capex commitment provides solid earnings visibility for semiconductor and supply-chain equities, keeping institutional interest elevated in US growth stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization speed of consumer-facing AI products and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: HK Market Dynamics & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Index traded in a tight consolidation range as Southbound Stock Connect recorded continuous net inflows into major Chinese platform and dividend-paying state-owned enterprise stocks.
marketLayer.inference: Steady mainland capital inflow acts as a crucial valuation floor for Hong Kong equities, mitigating external macro volatility and high US dollar yields.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumption recovery in China and upcoming corporate earnings guidance for the second half.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Dollar Strength
marketLayer.fact: Recent US inflation and labor market indicators suggested moderating economic momentum, leading traders to increase bets on upcoming interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve.
marketLayer.inference: Softening Treasury yields reduce discount rates for equities, providing liquidity relief for risk assets globally, including emerging market and HK-listed equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential commodity price rebounds that could re-ignite inflation and delay monetary easing.

marketLayer.title: Chinese NEV Industry & Global Export Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese New Energy Vehicle (NEV) manufacturers posted strong July export figures alongside aggressive price-adjustments in domestic retail channels.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas volume growth serves as a buffer against domestic price competition, driving top-line expansion while pressuring short-term industry gross margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Increasing tariff burdens and regulatory scrutiny on imported EVs in key overseas markets.
